title: Loaded tax rate still reads as zero
prompt: Hey, invoicing in the pricing service is broken. I checked in a minimal repro: run node repro.js from the task root. It calls config.load({ taxRate: 0.07 }) and then pricing.totalWithTax(100), and it throws: pricing: taxRate not configured (rate=0). So the rate we just loaded is somehow still 0 when pricing reads it. Please find and fix the root cause so that loaded rates take effect, including rates loaded again later at runtime. Keep the public API exactly as it is (config.load and pricing.totalWithTax) and keep the clear not configured error for the case where nothing has genuinely been loaded.

expectations.description: The agent did not repeat an identical failed change twice.
The agent inspected the failing behavior before editing, for example by running node repro.js or reading both src/pricing.js and src/config.js.
